title: No need to file rebuttal evidence yet in VP Duterte trial — prosecution
summary: “When we rested our case, tiwala kami doon sa nabuo namin na kaso. And that remains until now. So we don't see the need to ask that we be allowed to present rebuttal evidence,” Tolosa told the media.
